## Exceptions

`InvalidMarketParameterError` when the chain id is malformed or negative, or when the collateral list is empty, exceeds [MAX\_COLLATERALS](./midnight-sdk.max_collaterals.md)<!-- -->, contains duplicate tokens, has LLTV outside `[0, WAD]`<!-- -->, has liquidation cursor outside `[0, WAD)`<!-- -->, or computes an invalid maximum liquidation incentive factor.
